purpose: Transparent two-suite operating model for collective decision-making; not an accountant-approved forecast

legal_full_time_hours.note: Annual legal working-time reference; paid leave must not be subtracted a second time.

initial_capex_ttc.treatment: excluded from annual operating result, debt and depreciation model

vat.interpretation: The applicable regime depends on the year, prior turnover, activity mix and any voluntary election. V5 uses vat_real as the prudent maturity case, without deciding the legal treatment.

trajectory.status_note: Launch-year staffing, VAT and cash gap remain to be rebudgeted after supplier quotes.
Intermediate target; it is not the active maturity reference.

trajectory.interpretation: Commercially demanding but capped at a workload level considered discussable for two suites. All take rates, baskets and direct-booking performance must be demonstrated in operation.

recommended_sustainable_configuration.interpretation: Lean reference under explicit constraints. It prioritizes one full-time Jules position, paid continuity and a small prudent balance. It does not finance an SCI rent. The approximate balance must be reconciled after the simulator v5 formulas, supplier quotes and payroll simulation are frozen.

full_time_and_rent_goal.interpretation: At 81,840 EUR TTC public sales, the active v5 reference cannot finance both one full-time position and a 10,000 EUR SCI rent. Rent remains a contractual scenario input, never an automatic residual.

turnover_linen_and_consumables_per_stay_.workload_rule: Reference pairs this cash cost with 4 internal housekeeping hours per stay. Set internal hours to zero only when the supplier quote covers all modeled work.

spa_direct_cost_per_sale_ttc.note: Low-tech or wood-fired equipment may reduce cash costs but can increase preparation, heating, cleaning and supervision time.

fixed_operating_cost_budget_ttc.allocation_rule: Each line must be supported by a quote and assigned to OpCo, SCI or shared according to the lease and actual beneficiary.
fixed_operating_cost_budget_ttc.warning: Do-it-yourself savings are acceptable only when the corresponding labor, responsibility and continuity are explicitly assigned.

workload_model.presence_days: 1.2 * nights_per_suite; heuristic pending real booking calendar
workload_model.operations_hours: base_property_hours + client_presence_hours + occupied_suite_night_hours + stay_coordination_hours + internalized_turnover_hours + spa_service_hours + dining_service_hours
workload_model.internalized_turnover_hours: stays * internal_turnover_hours_per_stay; set to zero only when the quoted turnover service covers all modeled tasks
workload_model.spa_service_hours: spa_sales * spa_hours_per_sale; includes preparation, heating, cleaning, testing and supervision applicable to the chosen equipment
workload_model.calendar_support_floor: round_to_50(100 + 2 * nights_per_suite), bounded between 250 and 500 hours
workload_model.planned_paid_support_hours: exact simulator input; never increased silently
workload_model.warning: Annual heuristics do not replace a named weekly roster respecting daily and weekly rest. Family hours are a coverage assumption whose corporate, labor-law and insurance treatment requires professional validation.

staffing_options.active_reference: 1.0 FTE Jules + 350 paid support hours + 100 declared and rostered family hours
preferred_paid_cover_to_quote: seasonal part-time employee when demand calendar is predictable
local employer group for recurring partial needs
short extra shifts only for genuine peaks or replacements

conditions_before_modeling: identify eligible training and school calendar
price employer cost and public aid
verify working-time, weekend, night and minor rules
apprenticeship.warning: An apprentice is a trained employee, not autonomous low-cost continuity cover.

interpretation_rules: The validated public launch range remains 180 to 220 EUR. The 220 EUR v5 average is a maturity target and requires a working public range around 200 to 250 EUR, subject to associate approval and market proof.
The 13k TTC fixed-cost budget is a lean target, not a verified fact. The simulator must preserve an 18k TTC stress case until every line has a quote and an OpCo or SCI allocation.
The 28k full-time employer budget is provisional and requires an Urssaf simulation, payroll quote and collective-agreement review.
The 350 paid support hours and 100 family hours must become a named calendar. Savings achieved by internalizing cleaning, spa or maintenance tasks must appear as hours.
The v5 reference prioritizes full-time employment over SCI rent. A contractual rent can only be introduced if operating evidence creates sufficient margin.
Debt, depreciation, corporate tax and owner remuneration are outside this simplified annual model.
